abort.already_configured: Renault Zoe New is already configured.

user.title: Zoe New Extended
user.description: Add extended controls, diagnostics, and smart charging support for Renault Zoe New.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Choose one language for all Renault ZOE dashboard pages and enable or disable the complete IMMAX module. Disabling IMMAX hides its tab and stops its automations.

smart_charging.title: Smart charging settings
smart_charging.description: Select the zones where smart charging may control the car and the Nord Pool price area used by the planner.

cost_model.title: Energy cost model
cost_model.description: Configure the values used for charge-session costs, battery inventory value, and fallback trip estimates.

data.elektrum_drive_enabled: Detect Elektrum Drive stations and tariffs

charging_accounts.title: Charging accounts
charging_accounts.description: Manage Mobilly, Elektrum Drive, Ignitis ON, and IKRAUTAS accounts. Configured accounts: {account_count}. Transactions from all enabled accounts are merged without double-counting overlapping sessions.

renault_account.title: Renault account login
renault_account.description: Choose the official Renault config entry that should be signed in again. Credentials and login tokens remain owned by the official Renault integration.

renault_credentials.title: Sign in to Renault account
renault_credentials.description: Enter the credentials for the selected official Renault config entry. The password and refreshed login token are saved only in that Renault entry.

renault_kamereon.title: Select Renault account
renault_kamereon.description: This login has more than one My Renault account. Select the account used by this Home Assistant entry.

mobilly_account.title: Mobilly account
mobilly_account.description: {mode} a Mobilly account. Enter a phone number for app history and live data; web username/password are optional and add older statement history. Leave the password empty while editing to keep the saved password.

mobilly_mobile.title: Link Mobilly app
mobilly_mobile.description: Send a Mobilly verification code for {account_name}. The app session is used for live connector availability and prices.

mobilly_otp.title: Confirm Mobilly app
mobilly_otp.description: Enter the SMS code sent to the phone ending in {phone_suffix}.

elektrum_mobile_login.title: Log in to Elektrum Drive
elektrum_mobile_login.description: Complete the verification at {captcha_url}, then use its one-time solution to send an SMS code for {account_name}. The CAPTCHA solution and SMS code are never stored.

elektrum_mobile_verify.title: Confirm Elektrum Drive login
elektrum_mobile_verify.description: Enter the SMS code sent to the phone ending in {phone_suffix}.

elektrum_app_link.title: Import linked Elektrum Drive profile
elektrum_app_link.description: Paste the complete elektrumdrive:// app link handed from the signed-in Elektrum app to Elektrum Drive for {account_name}. Home Assistant validates the linked agreement and transaction API before replacing the saved session. The link is never logged or stored.

elektrum_account.title: Elektrum Drive account
elektrum_account.description: {mode} an Elektrum Drive app account. Leave the access token and device ID empty while editing to keep their saved values. If a postpaid agreement is already visible in the official app, use that app profile's access token and device ID instead of linking the agreement again.

elektrum_link_agreement.title: Link Elektrum agreement
elektrum_link_agreement.description: Start secure Smart-ID verification for the {account_name} postpaid agreement. The personal code is sent once to Elektrum over HTTPS and is never stored by Home Assistant.

elektrum_smart_id.title: Confirm with Smart-ID
elektrum_smart_id.description: Approve the Smart-ID request that shows verification code {verification_code}. Then confirm below and continue.

elektrum_select_agreement.title: Select Elektrum agreement
elektrum_select_agreement.description: Choose the postpaid agreement whose exact charging transactions should be synchronized.

ampeco_account.title: Operator app account
ampeco_account.description: {mode} a {provider} account. Use the email belonging to the same profile in the official operator app. Authentication tokens stay in the Home Assistant config entry.

ampeco_auth.title: Authenticate operator app
ampeco_auth.description: Choose an authentication method supported by the official {provider} app for the {email} account. The operator may disable email sign-in.

ampeco_password.title: Authenticate operator app
ampeco_password.description: Enter the password for the {provider} account {email}. The password is sent directly to the operator over HTTPS and is never stored by Home Assistant.

ampeco_google.title: Authenticate with the official Android app token
ampeco_google.description: Paste a fresh access token issued to the official {provider} Android app for the {email} account. A normal Google OAuth or OAuth Playground token will be rejected. Home Assistant exchanges the token once and does not store it.

ampeco_login_link.title: Authenticate operator app
ampeco_login_link.description: A one-time {provider} sign-in link was requested for {email}. After it arrives, copy the complete link from the email without opening it, paste it below, and continue. The one-time link is never stored.

remove_charging_account.title: Remove charging account
remove_charging_account.description: Remove {account_name} and its saved authentication data? Historical HA states are not deleted.

immax_setpoints.title: IMMAX setpoints
immax_setpoints.description: Configure the IMMAX charging controller. These values are synchronized with the existing Home Assistant helpers after saving.

immax_entities.title: IMMAX entity sources
immax_entities.description: Select the Home Assistant entities used by the IMMAX controller. Charger control, current, and the site load meter are required; other measurement or status sources may be left empty and are then excluded. Calculated values remain read-only.

error.ampeco_connection_failed: Could not connect to the operator app service.
error.ampeco_email_invalid: Enter the email used by this operator account.
error.ampeco_google_exchange_failed: The operator rejected this token. A normal Google OAuth or OAuth Playground token is not accepted; use a fresh token issued to the official Android app.
error.ampeco_google_token_invalid: Enter a fresh access token issued to the official Android app.
error.ampeco_login_link_exchange_failed: The operator rejected or expired this sign-in link. Request a new link and try again.
error.ampeco_login_link_failed: The operator did not send a sign-in link. Email sign-in may be disabled for this account.
error.ampeco_login_link_invalid: Paste the complete sign-in link from the operator email.
error.ampeco_password_exchange_failed: The operator rejected the email or password.
error.elektrum_agreement_link_failed: Elektrum did not switch the account to the selected postpaid agreement.
error.elektrum_app_link_invalid: Paste the complete elektrumdrive://app/open link from the official Elektrum app.
error.elektrum_app_link_unlinked: This app link belongs to an Elektrum Drive profile without a postpaid agreement. The saved session was not changed.
error.elektrum_authorization_failed: Smart-ID succeeded, but Elektrum could not attach the agreement to this Drive app profile. If the agreement already appears in the official app, import that app profile's access token and device ID instead.
error.elektrum_connection_failed: Could not connect to the Elektrum Drive service.
error.elektrum_captcha_required: Complete the Elektrum FriendlyCaptcha and provide its valid one-time solution.
error.elektrum_linked_session_required: The new app session belongs to an unlinked Elektrum profile. The existing linked Drive session was kept.
error.elektrum_no_agreements: Elektrum did not return any postpaid agreements for this person.
error.elektrum_history_validation_failed: The linked Elektrum profile opened, but its transaction history endpoint did not. The saved session was not changed.
error.elektrum_phone_invalid: Enter a valid Elektrum Drive phone number and country calling code.
error.elektrum_personal_code_invalid: Enter a valid 11-digit Latvian personal code.
error.elektrum_personal_code_required: Enter the personal code used for the Elektrum agreement.
error.elektrum_session_expired: The Elektrum Drive app session has expired. Update this account's access token first.
error.elektrum_smart_id_failed: Smart-ID verification failed or was declined. Start the agreement link again.
error.elektrum_smart_id_complete_failed: Elektrum did not complete the verified Smart-ID session. Start the agreement link again.
error.elektrum_smart_id_not_confirmed: Approve the Smart-ID request before continuing.
error.elektrum_smart_id_pending: Smart-ID is still waiting for approval. Approve it and continue again.
error.elektrum_smart_id_start_failed: Elektrum could not start Smart-ID verification. Check the personal code and try again.
error.elektrum_sms_code_required: Enter the Elektrum Drive SMS code.
error.elektrum_sms_start_failed: Elektrum Drive could not send the SMS code. Complete a fresh CAPTCHA and try again.
error.elektrum_sms_verify_failed: Elektrum Drive rejected the SMS code. Request a fresh code and try again.
error.mobilly_credentials_required: Enter both Mobilly web credentials or a phone number for app authentication.
error.mobilly_mobile_connection_failed: Could not connect to the Mobilly app service.
error.mobilly_otp_failed: Mobilly rejected the SMS code. Request a new code and try again.
error.mobilly_otp_start_failed: Mobilly could not send an SMS code to this number.
error.mobilly_phone_invalid: Enter the Mobilly phone number in international format.
error.renault_connection_failed: Could not connect to Renault. Try again later.
error.renault_invalid_credentials: Renault rejected the username or password.
error.renault_no_account: Renault returned no My Renault account for this login.
error.soc_resume_must_exceed_stop: Battery SOC resume threshold must be higher than the stop threshold.
error.solar_max_must_reach_min: Maximum solar charging power must be at least the minimum power.

abort.renault_account_not_found: No official Renault config entry was found. Add the Renault integration first.
